description: Push 5: five buttons, each putting out a voltage on its own jack

params.text: Puts its on voltage at the output of the same number while it is held down; its own menu can make it send a 1ms trigger at each press instead, or flip state at each press and stay there

outputs.text: Carries the on or off voltage of the button of the same number, 10V and 0V to begin with, and monophonic unless that button's menu sets more channels

menu: Button mode, in a button's own right-click menu — Trigger, Gate or Toggle
On value, in a button's own right-click menu — the voltage the output carries while the button is on: 10 V, 5 V, 1 V, 0 V, -1 V, -5 V, -10 V, or Custom
Off value, in a button's own right-click menu — the voltage the output carries while the button is off, from the same list, or Custom
On Color, in a button's own right-click menu — the colour the button lights while it is on: Red, Yellow, Blue, Green, Purple, Orange, White, their Dim versions, Dim Gray, or Off
Off Color, in a button's own right-click menu — the colour the button lights while it is off, from the same list
Polyphony channels, in a button's own right-click menu — how many identical channels that button's output carries, 1 to 16
Configure all buttons: — a heading on the module's own menu, above copies of those items that apply to all five buttons at once
